info.description: Appointment management backend: accounts, patients and the user-patient access model.
info.title: Appointment System API

get.description: Lists doctors in any status, oldest first. Use status=pending for the review queue.
Returns a doctor in any status with its verification history, newest first.

post.description: A reason is required and is stored in the verification history. The doctor resubmits by updating the profile, which moves it back to pending.
A reason is required. A suspended doctor disappears from search.
Log in with exactly one of email or mobileNo and a password.
Revokes the refresh token. Logging out an unknown token still succeeds.
Rotates the refresh token and returns a new jwtToken and refreshToken.

get.description: Lists verified doctors who accept patients. Speciality and tag match any of the given values; all other filters must all match.

parameters.description: Free text over name, qualification, bio and tags
parameters.name: q

post.description: Creates the profile for a doctor account. It starts as pending and is not searchable until an admin verifies it.

put.description: Replaces the profile. A rejected profile, or a verified one whose registration details change, goes back to pending.

get.description: Weekly rules and the overrides from today on. Times are in the clinic timezone.

put.description: Replaces every weekly rule. dayOfWeek is 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday); times are HH:MM in the clinic timezone, endTime may be 24:00. Blocks on the same day may not overlap, each must fit one slot, and the mode must be one the doctor offers. An empty list clears the schedule.

post.description: For one date from today up to a year ahead. Not available without times is a whole day off; not available with times is a partial leave; available with times is an extra session.
post.summary: Add a leave or an extra session

get.description: Returns a verified doctor. Doctors in any other status are reported as not found.
Free slots of a verified doctor on one date, from today up to 90 days ahead: weekly rules, minus leave, plus extra sessions. Slots already started today are left out.
get.summary: List a doctor's free slots for a day

get.description: Lists the patients the caller has active access to. Limit defaults to 20 and is capped at 100.

post.description: Creates a patient and links it to the caller with full access.

get.description: Returns a patient the caller has active access to. Other patients are reported as not found.

put.description: Updates a patient. Requires full access to the patient.

get.description: The controlled list of speciality slugs a doctor profile and search can use.

reason.example: Registration number not found in the council register

bio.example: Physician focused on diabetes and thyroid care.
